VBO:0201173.summary: Smooth Salukis tend to be dignified and independent, with a reserved manner around strangers. Their graceful bearing accompanies a hunting heritage built on speed and endurance across the Middle East. The breed developed local types suited to different terrain and game; the smooth variety keeps those shared characteristics in a coat without feathering.
VBO:0201173.shortDescription: Dignified, independent smooth Salukis pair reserve around strangers with a Middle Eastern heritage of fast coursing.
